skill.displayName: AI Breast Expansion – Natural Body Proportion Editing for Photos Online – CLI-powered
skill.summary: Edit body proportions in photos using AI — adjust breast size via text prompt, with optional image input

latestVersion.changelog:
ai-breast-expansion-cli-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Enables AI-based adjustment of breast size in photos via CLI, supporting both image editing and prompt-only generation.
- Requires weshop-cli and a WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
- Flexible prompt system with default and custom sizing options.
- Output includes status and resulting image URLs.
